purpose: Define the field bridge for C without inventing coupled evidence from the direct target or nuisance channels.

required_outputs.target_link_confidence: independent evidence that the response is attributable to the focal actor/interaction rather than arbitrary local motion

response_measurement.focal_trace: frame-to-frame mean absolute grayscale change in the focal zone, normalized by 255
response_measurement.reference_trace: median of predeclared neighbouring reference-zone motion traces
response_measurement.local_response_excess: max(0, focal_rms - reference_rms) / (focal_rms + reference_rms), zero if both are static
response_measurement.semantics: uncalibrated local-response process score, not probability

attribution_input.fail_closed_rule: without a valid independent attribution cue, target_link_confidence = 0 and usable coupled target score = 0

hard_independence_rules: coupled_response_score cannot be copied from PolliPi direct target evidence
target_link_confidence cannot be copied from PolliPi direct target evidence
neither coupled field quantity may be defined as 1 - nuisance
nuisance truth cannot be used as a runtime input to create positive coupled evidence
known biological truth or coupling truth cannot be consumed at held-out runtime
shared focal/reference motion is not by itself a local coupled response
runtime_combination: usable coupled target route = coupled_response_score * target_link_confidence
freeze_requirements_remaining: select and implement the concrete independent attribution/link source
freeze attribution scoring/calibration from development-only data
bind response/reference geometry and attribution evidence to the realised pre-scoring manifest
verify no target/nuisance/truth leakage in runtime inputs
register the final coupled-field artifact SHA-256 before held-out scoring
claim_boundary: Local-response measurement is development-implemented, but C remains held-out blocked until an independently calibrated attribution source is frozen. No indirect-rescue field claim is authorized.
